references.why: Quoted verbatim twice — in Ryle's conversion account (read with emphatic pauses; OLCB wording kept, em-dash pauses preserved) and on his gravestone (first clause). OLCB: «Mwalokolebwa lwa kisa olw'okukkiriza…».

note: The only chapter:verse scripture is Ephesians 2:8, quoted verbatim twice and pasted from the OLCB. 'Ephesians 2' as a bare citation is localized (Abaefeso 2). Ryle's own quoted words and the two blockquote maxims are prose (self).
